data.one_liner: Simple Flutter widget to fade-in your widgets once they are mounted.
data.what_it_does: Provides a FadeIn widget that automatically fades its child into view once mounted. Supports custom durations, curves, and manual control using an optional FadeInController.
use_when: You need a simple fade-in transition when widgets first appear on screen.
You want optional imperative control over the fade-in and fade-out timing via a controller.
avoid_when: You need complex physics-based or multi-stage choreography animations.
You require complex state management solutions for animations.
strengths: Very easy to install and use with minimal boilerplate.
Supports both Material and Cupertino widgets.
Includes an optional controller for more precise timing control.
weaknesses: Limited to fade-in and fade-out animations.
No built-in support for complex sequencing out of the box beyond basic controller triggers.
data.minimal_example:
FadeIn(
  child: Text("This will be faded-in!"),
  duration: Duration(milliseconds: 250),
  curve: Curves.easeIn,
)
